about_the_game:
COSMIST is a strategy game set among the stars in the beloved style of engaging arcades. Conquer the stars, bargain with gods, and outwit fate in fast.

You awaken in a world where galactic empires rise and fall beneath the gaze of ancient cosmic deities. As the newly reborn Emperor, your destiny is written among the stars—if you can survive the trials ahead.

In COSMIST, you’ll seize star sectors one by one, weighing ruthless efficiency against impossible bargains. Will you sacrifice a fleet to appease a capricious god, or gamble everything on a daring counterstrike? Play in brisk, satisfying sessions that blend arcade immediacy with thoughtful turn-based strategy—solo or alongside friends in a unique co-op mode.

Every sector is an adventure: chart mazes on living planets, strip asteroids for resources, upgrade space stations into bulwarks, and face divine interventions that twist the rules in your moment of triumph. Quick to learn, hard to master, endlessly replayable.

Key Features

  • Rule the Galaxy, One Sector at a Time — Expand your reign through bite-sized campaigns that deliver meaningful choices and escalating stakes.

  • Command Your Emperor — Choose from various emperors, each with unique strengths and trade-offs that shape your playstyle.

  • Fast, Focused Strategy — Tight turn-based encounters with the allure of classic arcades — easy to pick up, hard to stop.

  • Mine Resources and Upgrade Planets — Harvest resources and research enhancements to unlock new tactics and beef up your fleet.

  • Ancient Deities — Negotiate, placate, or defy powerful beings who bend combat, economy, and exploration with sector-wide edicts.

  • Endless Adventures and Quests — Each sector packs dozens of planets, asteroids, maze-worlds, and space stations to discover and exploit.

  • PvP Turn-Based Mode or Crush the Soulless AI — Challenge your friends or take on relentless AI foes across varied objectives and deity-twisted challenges.

  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600 (AMD or NVIDIA equivalent)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Conquer the galaxy in this arcade-like strategy game. Pick and send your generals to deploy the fleet in the far-off star sectors, mine resources, and upgrade your ships forgeries. Deities might interfere with your plans.
